title: Self-test: phishing login opened while another tab floods the model with 30 churning password frames
description: Not part of the blind set. A second tab (floodTab) holds 30 frames that each ask for a password and change every 0.6 s, so they keep asking to be checked. The victim then opens a fresh-domain bank phish in their own tab. The phish must still be checked and stopped in time.
